prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create one polished high-fidelity portrait native mobile HOME SCREEN design for Cash Flow, an Indonesian shared household money-recording app. This is a flat edge-to-edge app artboard, aspect ratio 390:844, not a photographed phone, no perspective, no decorative background or extra surrounding devices. Show a plausible iPhone safe-area status bar and a four-destination native bottom tab bar: Beranda, Transaksi, Anggaran, Keluarga. Text must be clean, readable Indonesian, using system sans typography and tabular money digits. Household identity Keluarga Budi is visible in the top navigation, with a small disclosure control for switching households. A single visible plus button in the top toolbar adds transactions; it is an action, not a fifth tab. Main visual task is reading the household's recorded balance and cashflow, then adding a transaction. These are synthetic demo data, so show a small understated 'Data contoh' label. Exact financial data: Saldo tercatat Rp12.672.500; period Oktober 2026; Pemasukan Rp8.000.000; Pengeluaran Rp327.500; Arus kas Rp7.672.500. The balance is labeled 'Saat ini', and the period metrics labeled 'Bulan ini'. Anggaran Belanja: Rp325.000 dari Rp1.500.000, Sisa Rp1.175.000. Recent activity is a single transfer Bank Keluarga → E-wallet Rp500.000 with Biaya admin Rp2.500 as its subordinate detail, a Belanja transaction −Rp325.000, and Gaji +Rp8.000.000. If showing account balances, Bank Keluarga Rp12.172.500 and E-wallet Rp500.000. All money values must match exactly, no made-up bank connectivity, no claim actual bank balance. Prioritize clear hierarchy and realistic 44pt touch targets. No illustrations, no marketing claims, no invented charts, no QR code, no giant logo, no gradients. Direction D, the familiar finance-app category standard executed with care: white background #FFFFFF, dark navy text #142136, saturated blue #2563EB. A compact household header, one solid blue balance panel with white text, a clearly labeled month selector directly below, a three-row monthly cashflow summary, a simple horizontal budget-progress section, then recent transactions on white. Native tab bar and outlined rounded plus toolbar control. No gradients, no illustration, no glass effects. Straightforward familiar contemporary mobile finance structure with exact numbers and high legibility.
